spec.hypothesis: Multi-seed error bars (plan_017): 3 different calibration subsets on Qwen2.5-7B, each runs constrained MCKP (k=8) + uniform 4-bit eval. Reports mean±std for statistical credibility. Dream review flagged all-single-run as critical gap.

experiment_data.notes:
3 seeds 全部完成，总耗时 3.33h。Constrained MCKP (hires profiling, k=8) mean±std = 10.9878 ± 0.0648。Bit distribution 完全一致：{2:8, 4:100, 8:4}。Allocation agreement 90.2%（101/112 heads 三个 seed 一致）。结果高度稳定，std/mean < 0.6%，证明分配对 calibration 数据子集不敏感。

注意：这是 hires profiling 结果（64×2048），与 hires_mckp_reeval 的单 seed 10.9131 一致（在 1σ 内）。Standard profiling 的 multi-seed 数据暂无（standard = lowres 16×512）。
